hooks.command: case "$(uname -s 2>/dev/null)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) exit 0;; esac; if [ -n "$AGENTIC_DEEP_AUDIT_PYTHON" ]; then "$AGENTIC_DEEP_AUDIT_PYTHON" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/pre_tool_policy.py" --strict-runtime; else echo "hook_misconfigured: AGENTIC_DEEP_AUDIT_PYTHON is required" >&2; exit 2; fi

if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -eq 'Core' -and $PSVersionTable.Platform -ne 'Win32NT') { exit 0 }; if ($env:AGENTIC_DEEP_AUDIT_PYTHON) { & $env:AGENTIC_DEEP_AUDIT_PYTHON (Join-Path $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT 'hooks/pre_tool_policy.py') --strict-runtime; exit $LASTEXITCODE } else { Write-Error 'hook_misconfigured: AGENTIC_DEEP_AUDIT_PYTHON is required'; exit 2 }
